title: Além do Tempo: Revelations that change the course of the soap opera
seoTitle: Além do Tempo: Revelations change the soap opera's course
subtitle: Discover why the September 12 and 14 episodes are trending
excerpt: In recent Além do Tempo episodes, Bernardo reveals he's Guillermo Ventura's son, Melissa fears losing the baby, and Felipe seeks custody of his son, generating.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: Notícias da TV, Jornal Correio, Jornal de Brasília
contentHtml:
The episodes broadcast on September 12 and 14 sent the ratings of the soap opera Além do Tempo soaring, as they bring revelations that alter the future of several families. Bernardo's secret, Melissa's tension, and Felipe's despair are the main drivers of discussion among viewers.

Bernardo reveals he is Guillermo Ventura's son

In both broadcasts, Bernardo (Felipe Camargo) tells Vitória (Irene Ravache) that he is Guillermo Ventura's biological son. This information puts the sale of the Ventura winery at risk, since the blood heir did not approve the negotiation. Vitória immediately thinks about canceling the transaction and encourages Bernardo to get closer to Bento, indicating a possible forced reconciliation.

Melissa fears losing the baby and asks for secrecy

Melissa (Paolla Oliveira) appears distressed upon receiving the DNA test results. The hair strand used in the test was not Lívia's, as Solange reveals, which raises suspicions of manipulation. Terrified, Melissa fears she has lost the baby and requests that Dorotéia keep the situation a complete secret.

Felipe seeks custody of his son and faces debts

Felipe (Rafael Cardoso) is seeking custody of his missing son and decides to travel to Rio de Janeiro. At the same time, he consults with Massimo about the debts that have been tightening his budget, showing the financial pressure accompanying his storyline.

Romantic conflicts and unexpected alliances

Lívia (Alinne Moraes) and Felipe spend the night together, while Bento (Luiz Carlos Vasconcelos) kisses Rosa (Carolina Kasting). Emília (Ana Beatriz Nogueira) is distressed to learn about Bernardo's paternity and blames Luiz for the confusion. Gema (Louise Cardoso) decides to postpone her wedding to Queiroz (Zécarlos Machado), and Raul (Val Perré) awaits the next step in their relationship.

Developments at the winery and in family relationships

The revelation about Bernardo's identity puts the Ventura winery at risk of “turning to dust,” according to Jornal de Brasília. Meanwhile, Pedro (character not detailed) is rude to Carola, and Alberto warns that he is about to arrive in Brazil, foreshadowing new conflicts.

Expectations for upcoming episodes

Recent episodes establish Bernardo as an emotional protagonist, while Melissa becomes the subject of general concern. The hair strand switched by Solange promises to trigger new confrontations, and the relationship between Solange and Lívia is expected to spark more discussions in the coming weeks.

With information from Notícias da TV, Jornal Correio, Jornal de Brasília.
